svg.aria-label: Hub-spoke topology: admin SSH reaches the jumpbox, the jumpbox reaches the workload VM over peering, the VM reaches blob storage only through a private endpoint, and its 0.0.0.0/0 route ends at Azure Firewall, which drops it.
